117999.name: Chabad of Valley Stream
117999.note: Chabad of Long Island's page for Chabad of Valley Stream (550 Rockaway Ave; read Nov 10 2026): 'Chabad Outreach Center, founded in 1994, is nurtured by concerned members in the Valley Stream area'; in 1998 it affiliated with Congregation Beth Shalom, and 'In 2005, the two successfully united as one.' Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then. Director: Yitzchak Goldshmid.

118923.name: Cong. Beth Shalom
118923.note: Chabad of Long Island's page for Chabad of Valley Stream (read Nov 10 2026): the Chabad Outreach Center (founded 1994) became affiliated with Congregation Beth Shalom in 1998, and 'In 2005, the two successfully united as one.' Medium: the year the congregation joined Chabad; the congregation itself is older. Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then. Director: Yitzchak Goldshmid.

118489.name: Chabad of Watermill
118489.note: Chabad of Long Island's page for Chabad of Watermill (in Firecrawl's search index and read Nov 10 2026): 'In a classic story of Chabad grassroots growth, Chabad of Watermill was founded in 1994 when philanthropist George Rohr requested a Shabbos minyan'; the first season was in a rented house. Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then. Director: Levi Baumgarten.
